Thanks Susan — appreciate the quick turnaround and the PO.

High level proposal (mutual action plan):
1) We issue two invoices:
   - Invoice A (Committed capacity) — issued on receipt of signed PO and due on Net 30.
   - Invoice B (Final true-up) — issued after the renewal period close, with a 14 day payment term; will capture overage/underage against committed units.
2) Timeline:
   - 2 Nov: Redwood acknowledges PO and shares preliminary true-up worksheet (attached).
   - 12 Nov: Acme confirms usage reporting window/any disputed items.
   - 18 Nov: Redwood issues Invoice A (committed) + request for wire to escrow instructions.
   - 02 Dec: Redwood issues Invoice B (true-up) if applicable.
3) VAT: please send your EU VAT ID and billing address (we'll apply reverse charge if eligible). If you prefer Redwood to bill with VAT, we can provide our VAT number and local tax wording.

I've attached a draft "Final_TrueUp_Spreadsheet.xlsx" with the fields we'll populate; we can lock columns once Acme confirms. For escrow/wire beneficiary, I'm looping in Marissa and Karthik to confirm the final beneficiary account and whether we should invoice to the escrow name on the PO.

- Susan: confirm VAT ID and whether Acme will accept reverse charge
- Marissa / Karthik: confirm beneficiary and invoice split wording
